known_risks: 中文：已映射自动标记核心技能检查和当前区标记判定；3DS 端另有一个 UI 虚调用点在 PPC 中没有一对一静态对应，因此小怪图标覆盖范围可能不完整。 / English: Maps the core auto-marker skill checks and current-area marker tests; one 3DS UI virtual-call site has no one-to-one static PPC counterpart, so small-monster icon coverage may be incomplete.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #56“自动标记并标记当前区小怪”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #56 "Auto-Marker plus Current-Area Small Monsters" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
